sloka: मातङ्गयोर्मद्यगता शुभा नागवधूरिव ।एकैकम् पादपम् गुल्मम् लताम् वा पुष्पशालिनीम् ॥२-५५-३०॥
transliteration: mātaṅgayormadyagatā śubhā nāgavadhūriva ।ekaikam pādapam gulmam latām vā puṣpaśālinīm ॥2-55-30॥

translations.english: That gentle lady enquired of Rama about a tree or a shrub or a creeper in full bloom which she did not see before.
